sources: linear:WeDance (208 issues -> 151 stories; RAZ-59 merged into RAZ-23 and RAZ-205 into RAZ-110 (same story text); 53 bugs/chores/QA/follow-ups folded into notes or skipped; 2 Canceled skipped)
linear:no project (4 WeDance-app issues used as stories: RAZ-241, RAZ-251, RAZ-253, RAZ-272; other user-reports referenced in notes; template/other-repo issues ignored)
docs/issues (216 files; all 132 P/G promise files map 1:1 to Linear issues, RAZ-/WED- files are Linear archives — 0 new stories)
map:wedance-org 01_Domains/Festival_Experience/Product/meetup-planner/backlog.md + story-map.md (36 stories -> 24 entries; 12 merged into Linear entries or sibling map entries)
map:wedance-org 01_Domains/Festival_Experience/Product/festival-schedule/user-journey.md (1 entry; radar, check-in, rating, stats, loyalty merged into meetup entries)
map:wedance-org 01_Domains/Festival_Experience/Operations/Stories/*.yml (10 files; all merged into meetup-planner entries)
e2e/features/*.feature (3 files; merged into map:meetup-2.1-sign-up, RAZ-241, RAZ-136)
code: app/pages, server/trpc/routers (26 routers, 141 procedures), server/api, server/database/schema.ts (37 tables) at worktree HEAD

stories.title: Salsa Quick Pick
stories.story: As a beginner, I want a quick pick for Salsa described in plain words, so that I can tell at a glance whether it suits me.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Quick pick links to /cities?style=Salsa; the city page preselects the style filter. City content comes from /api/cities/[slug] + events, not a style-specific catalogue.

stories.title: Bachata Quick Pick
stories.story: As a beginner, I want a quick pick for Bachata described in plain words, so that I can tell at a glance whether it suits me.
stories.notes: Linear state: In Review. Same mechanism as RAZ-25.

stories.title: Kizomba Quick Pick
stories.story: As a beginner, I want a quick pick for Kizomba described in plain words, so that I can tell at a glance whether it suits me.
stories.notes: Linear state: In Review. Same mechanism as RAZ-25.

stories.title: Free Taster Class
stories.story: As a beginner, I want to just try a free taster class, so that I can experience a dance in person before committing to a style.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. "Taster" is derived client-side (shared/utils/taster isTasterCandidate/isFreePrice) from synced events; there is no taster flag in the data model.

stories.title: Free Tasters
stories.story: As a Seeker, I want to try free taster classes and choose a dance by how it feels, so that I can pick a style I love instead of guessing from a name.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Home journey stage 1 links to /find-your-dance (quiz is live, no longer "coming soon").

stories.title: Where To Start
stories.story: As a beginner, I want reassurance and a starting point when I don't know which dance is for me, so that I feel welcome instead of overwhelmed.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: Dance-Match Quiz
stories.story: As a beginner, I want a short quiz that matches me to a dance by how it feels, so that I can pick a style without knowing any dance terms.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Linear label status:not-built is stale: a client-side feeling-based quiz with a result + "find classes" link exists. No quiz answers are stored.

stories.title: Floor Movers
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to discover the artists who move the floor, so that I can find teachers, DJs, and performers I want to follow.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: Follow Artists
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to follow teachers, DJs, and performers, so that I can keep track of them across festivals and cities.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Follow targets profiles(type=artist). "Track across festivals" relies on events.byProfile matching the artist name/handle in events.artists; festival lineups (app/data mock teachers) are not linked to profiles.

stories.title: Artist Search
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to search artists by name or style, so that I can quickly find the ones I'm looking for.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: Artists by City
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to filter the artists directory by my city, so that I can find teachers and performers who are actually near me.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. City filter compares free-text profiles.city strings, not cities.id.

stories.title: Find Your Teacher
stories.story: As a Student, I want to browse real teacher profiles showing their styles, languages and schools, so that I can choose a teacher who fits how I want to learn.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. profiles has styles + languages; there is no "school" field, so the "schools" part of the promise has no data behind it. A second artist model exists in app/data/artists.ts (used by /artists/[id] and festival lineups).

stories.title: Artist profiles: one consistent layout, artist type, filterable properties
stories.story: As an organiser or dancer, I want artist profiles to share one layout and say what kind of artist they are (dancer, DJ, …) with filterable properties, so that I can understand at a glance why to choose this artist and find artists by type.
stories.notes: Linear state: Triage. Journey inferred (no cuj label). profiles.type only distinguishes venue/artist/organizer; there is no artist sub-type or service column. /artists/[id] (static app/data/artists.ts) and /@[handle] (DB profiles) are two different artist page implementations.

stories.title: City Community
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to find the venues, artists, and organizers in my city, so that I can connect with my local Cuban dance community.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Directory data comes from Nitro routes server/api/cities.get.ts and server/api/cities/[slug].get.ts (not tRPC).

stories.title: Real Numbers
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to see how many people are in each city's community, so that I can gauge how active a scene is.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. "Community size" = count of venue+artist+organizer profiles per citySlug, not people/dancers.

stories.title: Weekly Floor
stories.story: As a Regular, I want to find weekly socials and practicas I can attend with friends, so that I have a reliable place to dance every week with people I know.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Stage links to /cities/munich (hardcoded city).

stories.title: Every City
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to browse dance scenes across every city, so that I can explore communities wherever I am.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: One Events Feed
stories.story: As a regular, I want one city events feed that merges booked venue events with the weekly socials, so that I see everything happening without duplicate sections.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Follow-ups RAZ-223 (beyond-this-week bookings) and RAZ-224 (link to venue) are Done. The feed merges two event sources at read time: booking_requests ("a booking IS a scheduled event") and events (v3-synced).

stories.title: City this-week relevance filter + directory tabs
stories.story: As a regular, I want a city's venues/organisers/artists to surface who's active this week first, so the city page reflects the living local floor instead of a static roster.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: SEO city directory pages (venues / organisers / artists)
stories.story: As a dancer searching Google, I want dedicated, SEO-friendly directory pages for a city's venues/organisers/artists, so the local scene is discoverable and indexable outside the app shell.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: Real upcoming events mirrored from wedance.vip
stories.story: As a dancer, I want the city pages to show the real upcoming events already listed on wedance.vip, so that the calendar is not empty.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. No Linear project (PR tracking issue, chore that reveals a capability); journey inferred. Daily sync; events rows carry source=wedance-v3.

stories.title: Venue/organiser/artist profiles synced from wedance.vip
stories.story: As a dancer, I want the venues, organisers and artists behind synced events to have profiles linked from those events, so that I can explore who runs the scene.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. No Linear project (PR tracking issue); journey inferred. Events link to profiles by username text (events.venue_username/organizer_username), not FK. Follow-up RAZ-254 Done.

stories.title: Ticketing referral discounts
stories.story: As a traveling dancer viewing a friend's year, I want to buy a festival ticket through their link, so that we both get a discount.
stories.notes: Linear state: Todo. Merged with RAZ-59 (Done, same story text, promise P319). Follow-ups RAZ-266 (webhook completes referral) and RAZ-267 (referrer credit) Done. Journey taken from RAZ-59 labels. Discount % per festival is hardcoded in server/utils/ticket-prices.ts. referral.myReferrals exists but no UI calls it. Drift: Linear Todo while code is built.

stories.title: Auto-Fill Plan
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to tell WeDance what I'm into and have my plan filled for me, so that I start with the right festivals, classes and socials instead of a blank page.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Follow-up RAZ-231 Done. Festival auto-fill picks from the hardcoded my-plan catalogue by matching a style name inside the festival name (not festivals.styles); courses/socials prefer DB events with a mock fallback.

stories.title: Festivals Mapped
stories.story: As a Traveler, I want every festival mapped with the people who are going shown, so that I can plan trips around events where I'll know or meet other dancers.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. "Mapped" = listed with city/country; there is no map view.

stories.title: Be Their Partner
stories.story: As a dancer viewing a friend's year, I want to offer to be their partner at a festival, so that we can attend together.
stories.notes: Linear state: Backlog. Button exists but only emits open-festival; no partner offer is stored or delivered to the friend. No partner-request table.

stories.title: Plan Your Year
stories.story: As a dancer viewing someone else's year, I want to start planning my own, so that I can browse festivals, pick workshops, find partners, and share with friends.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: Festival Overlap
stories.story: As a traveling dancer viewing a friend's year, I want to see which festivals we both plan to attend, so that I know where we'll cross paths.
stories.notes: Linear state: In Review.

stories.title: Next Festival
stories.story: As a Traveler, I want a clear button in the hero that takes me to festivals, so that I can start discovering events to attend right away.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: Who's Going
stories.story: As a Traveler, I want to know I can see who is attending a festival before I buy, so that I feel confident I won't show up somewhere alone.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Linear label status:not-built is stale; attendee lists exist (GoingSection).

stories.title: Plan Together
stories.story: As a traveler, I want to coordinate the trip with other attendees, so that I can arrange dinners, share rides, and line up a first-night partner before I arrive.
stories.notes: Linear state: Backlog. Rides, dinners and waves are DB-backed; "first-night partner" has no dedicated flow (waves = mutual interest only). Extra activities are a hardcoded ref in the page. Linear Backlog but mostly built (reverse drift).

stories.title: One Place
stories.story: As a dancer, I want every festival I picked gathered in one place with a clear next action, so that I know what to do this week without hunting through pages.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: One Dashboard
stories.story: As a dancer, I want my picks, partners and tickets on one dashboard, so that I can follow one next step at a time instead of juggling everything.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Signed-out preview copy. "My partners" content is driven by localStorage progress (partnerFound), not DB.

stories.title: Do These First
stories.story: As a dancer, I want the three most important things across my plan surfaced for this week, so that I always know what to do first.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Priorities computed client-side from plan + localStorage track toggles.

stories.title: Arrive With Friends
stories.story: As a traveler, I want to already know a few people before I arrive at a festival, so that I can walk straight onto the floor instead of standing alone against the wall.
stories.notes: Linear state: Backlog. Waves (mutual = festival friends) let you connect with opted-in attendees; no meet-up planning. Linear Backlog while partially built (reverse drift). MySpace still receives mockFriends/mockPartnerMatches from the page.

stories.title: This Year's Festivals
stories.story: As a traveler, I want to see the festivals I'm going to this year on My Plan, so that I have a clear picture of where I'm headed.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: Your Compass
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to set dance goals on My Plan, so that I have a compass for where I'm headed.
stories.notes: Linear state: In Review. Goals are stored as plan_items rows with item_type='goal' (a goal is not a plannable item; overloaded table). RAZ-265/235/255 user reports on goals are Done.

stories.title: Year At A Glance
stories.story: As a traveler, I want a year-at-a-glance strip of chips on My Plan, so that I can jump straight to any part of my year.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: Pick Workshops
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to pick workshops from a festival's schedule, so that I can plan which classes I'll attend.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Two stores for the same picks: the festival page writes plan_items(item_type=workshop), My Plan's workshop picker reads/writes localStorage. Workshops, teachers and ticket tiers exist only for the hardcoded festivals in app/data/mock-*.ts (plus server/utils/ticket-prices.ts); there is no workshops or tickets table, so DB-only festivals get no schedule. Follow-up RAZ-283 Done.

stories.title: Ticket On Page
stories.story: As a traveler, I want each festival track in my plan to point me to where I buy the ticket, so that I can complete my booking on the festival page.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Ticket status syncs from festivalSignup.myTickets; other track toggles stay in localStorage.

stories.title: Find a Partner
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to find a dance partner for a festival, so that I don't have to go alone and have someone to dance with.
stories.notes: Linear state: Backlog. "Find one" links to the festival #discover deck (shows name, role, styles). No "looking for a partner" flag per festival; "partner found" is a localStorage toggle.

stories.title: Book Vacation
stories.story: As a traveling dancer, I want to add a festival's dates to my calendar, so that I can book time off work and protect the trip.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Google Calendar template URL only; no .ics export for other calendar apps.

stories.title: Where You Show Up
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to see the courses I attend this month, so that I know where I regularly show up to practice.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Courses are plan_items(item_type='event', metadata.type='class'); course fields are copied into metadata at enrol time. RAZ-294 (past classes shown) Done.

stories.title: Where You Dance
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to see the socials I'm attending this week, so that I know where I'm dancing and can plan my week.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: Find A Ride
stories.story: As a traveling dancer, I want to find a ride to a festival I'm going to, so that I can get there cheaply and meet other dancers on the way.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Covers map stories 3.1 (post a ride) and 3.2 (browse rides). No seat request/accept flow: one row per dancer per festival, offering|looking. RAZ-191 (ride without login) Done.

stories.title: Who's Out Tonight
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to see who's out dancing tonight, so that I can join friends and not miss the fun.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. hangouts.peopleCount is a stored counter next to hangout_rsvps (denormalised). RAZ-270 (creation failed) Done.

stories.title: Share A Room
stories.story: As a traveling dancer, I want to share a room with another dancer at a festival, so that I can save on accommodation and travel with company.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. A roommate "lookup" is only (festival, dancer): no dates, budget or preferences, so listings cannot show "what they are looking for" (AC3) and map stories 4.1/4.2 (room listing with preferences, request to join) are not covered. Hotel fallback exists. Follow-ups RAZ-295/296 in Triage.

stories.title: Styles Breakdown
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to see a breakdown of the dance styles in my year, so that I can understand where I spend my dancing time.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: Plan the Year
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to pick my next festival and plan my year, so that I know which events I'm heading to.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: Widen Your Year
stories.story: As a traveling dancer, I want to discover new people and places, so that my year can grow beyond what I already know and pull me somewhere new.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Needs dancer city + styles; RAZ-284 (empty deck) Done.

stories.title: Match Rate
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to see my partner match rate, so that I know how often I found a partner for the festivals I planned.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Match rate = festivals with a manual "partner found" toggle / planned festivals. State kept in browser localStorage, not the DB. Not linked to waves or any partner data.

stories.title: Festival Search
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to search festivals by city, style, or festival name, so that I can quickly find the ones that fit me.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Client-side text filter over /api/festivals rows (name, city, styles).

stories.title: My 2026 Year
stories.story: As a traveling dancer, I want a page that shows my 2026 dance year, so that I can see everything I have planned in one place.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: Track Your Year
stories.story: As a dancer who isn't signed in, I want to understand what My Year offers, so that I can decide to sign up and start tracking my dance year.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: Tap Going
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to mark a festival as Going, so that it is added to my year plan.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Also covered by e2e/features/auth-going-gate.feature. RAZ-230/RAZ-252/RAZ-256 (going without sign-in, not persisting, hardcoded count) Done.

stories.title: Year Snapshot
stories.story: As a traveling dancer, I want a headline summary of my year, so that I can see how many festivals, workshops, and countries I have planned at a glance.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Workshop count comes from plan_items(item_type=workshop) grouped by festival (server/trpc/routers/plan.ts).

stories.title: Early Bird Alert
stories.story: As a traveling dancer, I want to see when a festival's early-bird ticket is about to expire, so that I can buy before the price goes up.
stories.notes: Linear state: In Review. Early-bird deadline/offer are columns on festivals; ticket tiers themselves are not in the DB.

stories.title: Year In Numbers
stories.story: As a traveling dancer, I want a "My Year in Numbers" summary, so that I can look back on how much dancing I packed into the year.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: Year, Saved
stories.story: As a traveling dancer, I want my year plan saved on the server and my upcoming festivals shown on my profile with real friends going, so that my plan survives devices and others can see where I am headed.
stories.notes: Linear state: In Review. Implemented as generic plan_items(item_type=festival) instead of the dancer_festivals table the issue proposed. RAZ-300/RAZ-299 (my-year sync/stale stats, In Review) indicate client-cache issues.

stories.title: 🐞 I want the 'pay due' sign to be a clickable button that redirects me t…
stories.story: As a dancer enrolled in a course, I want the "Pay due" sign to be a button that takes me to pay for that course, so that I can settle what I owe.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Journey inferred (courses live in My Plan, C4). "Pay due" links to /events/[id]; there is no course payment flow or payment record.

stories.title: Activity cards with participant counts
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want to see activity cards with participant counts and availability, so that I can tell at a glance what is happening and how popular it is.
stories.notes: Source: meetup-planner backlog 1.2 + Operations/Stories/1.2-activity-cards.yml. Dinner/ride/room counts are real; "extra activities" cards are a hardcoded array in the page.

stories.title: "Your festival plan is ready" message
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want to receive a "Your festival plan is ready" message summarising my matches, so that I can see everything in one place and get excited.
stories.notes: Only magic-link, password-reset and ticket-confirmation emails exist in server/utils/email.ts.

stories.title: Check in to an activity / workshop
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want to check in to an activity or workshop to confirm I am attending, so that my group and the organiser know I am there.
stories.notes: Also festival-schedule user-journey step 5 ("Check-in to workshops"). No check-in field or procedure found.

stories.title: Live feed / live radar at the festival
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want a live feed of what is happening now (and an opt-in radar of where friends are), so that I can join spontaneous plans during breaks.
stories.notes: Merged with festival-schedule user-journey "Live radar" (user-journey.md:49). Closest code is city-level "Tonight · hangouts" (RAZ-118), which is not festival-scoped.

stories.title: Free-spot counter
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want to see how many free spots are left, so that I feel urgency to claim mine before they are gone.
stories.notes: Source: backlog 2.2 + Operations/Stories/2.2-free-spot-counter.yml. A free "join" writes festival_signups, a different table from "Going" (plan_items).

stories.title: €1 social unlock via Stripe
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want to pay €1 via Stripe when the free spots are full, so that I can still join the social activities.
stories.notes: Source: backlog 2.3 + Operations/Stories/2.3-stripe-payment-link.yml. festivals.stripePaymentLink column also exists for the older payment-link approach.

stories.title: Ride group chat link
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want a WhatsApp/Telegram group link with my ride group after matching, so that I can coordinate pickup.
stories.notes: festival_ride_shares has no group/chat link; only dinner groups have chatLink. Same gap for rooms (backlog 4.3).

stories.title: Automatic carpool matching
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want to be matched to a carpool automatically by origin city and dates, so that I get a ride within hours.
stories.notes: Ride shares are listed, not matched.

stories.title: Sign up for a group dinner
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want to sign up for a group dinner on a specific evening, so that I can meet new people instead of eating alone.
stories.notes: Source: backlog 5.1 + Operations/Stories/5.1-dinner-sign-up.yml. No Linear issue tracks the dinner feature.

stories.title: Assign dinner groups of 4–6
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want to be assigned to a dinner group of 4–6 people, so that I have a concrete dinner plan without organising it myself.
stories.notes: Source: backlog 5.2 (+5.5 auto-assign) and Operations/Stories/5.2. Grouping is computed by assignGroups but triggered by an admin; no diversity logic was verified.

stories.title: Dinner group chat link
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want a WhatsApp/Telegram link for my dinner group, so that I can start chatting before we meet.
stories.notes: Source: backlog 5.3 + Operations/Stories/5.3-dinner-chat-link.yml.

stories.title: Restaurant reveal on the day
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want to receive the restaurant name and address on the day of the dinner, so that I show up at the right place with the surprise intact.
stories.notes: Source: backlog 5.4 + Operations/Stories/5.4-restaurant-reveal.yml.

stories.title: Book a taxi dancer
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want to book a taxi dancer for specific time slots and styles, so that I am guaranteed good dances even if I know nobody.

stories.title: Join community-proposed activities
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want to browse and join community-proposed activities (beach social, city tour, after-party), so that I can fill gaps between workshops.
stories.notes: UI only: four hardcoded activities in a page-local ref; joining is not persisted. No activities table.

stories.title: Propose a festival activity
stories.story: As a festival regular, I want to propose a new activity with description, time and max participants, so that I can organise something without WhatsApp chaos.
stories.notes: Also covers backlog 9.2 (create and manage activities) and 9.3 (activity dashboard).

stories.title: Rate the festival afterwards
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want to rate my experience and leave feedback after the festival, so that I help improve future events.
stories.notes: Reviews are polymorphic (target_type, target_slug) with no FK. Rating per workshop/teacher (festival-schedule journey step 5) is not supported; teachers in lineups are mock data, not profiles.

stories.title: Post-festival recap and stats
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want a recap of my festival (workshops attended, rides shared, dinners, partners met), so that I can relive it and share it.
stories.notes: Merged with festival-schedule journey step 6 "festival stats" (user-journey.md:58).

stories.title: Invite to festivals where people I met are going
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want to be invited to upcoming festivals where dancers I met are already signed up, so that I can plan the next one with my crew.
stories.notes: plan.suggestions recommends festivals but not based on people met (waves).

stories.title: Persistent crew groups across festivals
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want to keep a persistent group with people I connected with across festivals, so that friendships outlast a single event.
stories.notes: Waves are scoped per festival_slug; there is no cross-festival friend/crew entity.

stories.title: Share local tips with festival visitors
stories.story: As a festival regular, I want to share local tips (restaurants, transport, hidden gems) visible to all attendees, so that I help visitors without answering the same DM ten times.
stories.notes: Ask-locals exists per city, not per festival, and recommendations are limited to organisers/venues (written as reviews).

stories.title: Ambassador status / loyalty
stories.story: As a festival regular, I want to earn ambassador status (and loyalty points toward free passes), so that I feel valued for organising and returning.
stories.notes: Merged with festival-schedule journey "Loyalty points" (user-journey.md:61).

stories.title: Compare workshop plans with friends
stories.story: As a festival dancer, I want to see which workshops my friends attend and compare schedules side by side, so that we can plan the festival together.
stories.notes: A shared plan is encoded into the URL (useSharePlan) and rendered read-only; friends' DB plans are not compared. MySpace receives mockFriends.

stories.title: Roles & Services
stories.story: As a member of the dance community, I want to see both open roles at events and services artists offer, so that I can either find work or find the right person for my event.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done.

stories.title: Apply Or Contact
stories.story: As a member of the dance community, I want to apply to or contact the poster of a gig, so that I can take the next step on a listing that fits me.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Apply/Contact opens a mailto: to gigs.contactEmail; nothing is stored, so "confirmation sent" is client-side only. Follow-ups RAZ-232/RAZ-260 Done.

stories.title: Post a Gig
stories.story: As an organizer, I want to post a gig from the Gigs page, so that artists can find and apply to my open role.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. gigs.close and gigs.getById exist but have no UI caller, so a poster cannot close their gig.

stories.title: Help Wanted
stories.story: As an organizer, I want to post an open role marked "Wanted", so that artists know I am looking to hire for my event.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. "Wanted" = kind role.

stories.title: Get Booked
stories.story: As an artist, I want a place where getting booked and booking others both happen, so that I can grow my dance work from one board.
stories.notes: Linear state: Done. Gig poster identity is free text (posterName/posterType) plus optional dancerId; not linked to profiles.

stories.title: Offer a Service
stories.story: As an artist, I want to post a service marked "Offering", so that organizers know what I do and can hire me.

stories.title: Sign up / sign in / sign out
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to sign up with name, email, dance styles, role and city in under a minute, sign out with confirmation and sign back in, so that I can start planning immediately and keep my account.
stories.notes: Merges meetup-planner 2.1 (+ Operations/Stories/2.1-sign-up-form.yml), e2e/features/auth-signup-signin.feature, and bug reports RAZ-239 (sign-out confirm, Done), RAZ-240 (redirect after sign-out, Done), RAZ-273 (session lost on refresh, In Review).

stories.title: Sign up with Google or Facebook
stories.story: As a dancer, I want to sign up with Google or Facebook, so that I can join in one tap without typing.
stories.notes: Auth is email+password and magic link only; dancers.neonAuthId column exists but no OAuth flow found.

stories.title: Event page: clear visitor journey + fix attendee section showing live data
stories.story: As a visitor on a festival or event page, I want a clear next step for going and an attendee section that shows the right content, so that I know what I can do here.
stories.notes: Linear state: Triage. Triage. The issue does not name which section shows live data instead of placeholder content, so status cannot be determined from code.
